bio.text: Nathaniel Hezekiah III is a deputy chief of staff to U.S. Rep. Gregory Meeks and previously served as Meeks' project manager and community liaison, according to the Queens Chronicle.
In February 2026 he declared his candidacy for the 32nd Assembly District in Queens, a seat Assemblywoman Vivian Cook said she would not seek re-election to after 35 years in office.
The Chronicle described him as a political staffer from South Jamaica.

sources.title: S. Jamaica political staffers vie for D 32
